requirements.requirement: Restore an executable /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver that reads one message from standard input and routes accounts, support, and all other messages to their respective Maildir new directories, matching header names case-insensitively.
requirements.summary: The entry point was installed and remained executable after restart. Direct deliveries routed the uppercase X-Department accounts sample to accounts, the lowercase x-department support sample to support, and the untagged sample to general.

requirements.requirement: Preserve every delivered message byte-for-byte and keep repeated-subject deliveries as separate messages.
requirements.summary: Hash and cmp checks established exact source/destination equality. Two deliveries of the same accounts message produced distinct files, and additional deliveries after restart also remained separate and exact.

requirements.requirement: Retain the staged sample messages unchanged.
requirements.summary: All three sample hashes matched the preparation baseline before modification, during verification, and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64. The implementation is a successfully executed POSIX-shell script using tools observed on the node, with no package installation or platform replacement shown.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied by direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: it records healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement and bounded loss of connectivity, a changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered routing, persisted deliveries, samples, OS, and kernel state. Only minor temporary-file residue detracts from operational hygiene.
limitations: Behavioral routing coverage uses the three staged samples, including uppercase, lowercase, and absent department headers; it does not exercise every possible RFC822 formatting variant such as folded headers.

Lifecycle filesystem observation is bounded and therefore does not independently inventory the complete final /srv tree, although executor commands directly verify the relevant entry point, samples, Maildir contents, and post-restart behavior.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear roles: installing the entry point and creating prerequisite Maildir paths (cmd-76467e5c7ae74dd6), bounded functional deliveries (cmd-bc2b1a09909c449d), the mandatory restart (cmd-36ac97437b984741), and post-restart recovery deliveries (cmd-7b01a7317a66492b). No unnecessary troubleshooting mutation was observed. Hygiene is reduced slightly because three executor-created temporary artifacts remained: /tmp/deliver.new and /tmp/mail-filter-routing-samples.before from cmd-76467e5c7ae74dd6, and /tmp/mail-filter-routing-reboot.log from cmd-36ac97437b984741. They were not reverted. No failed services, new exposure, or damaged package state was observed after execution.
